PROJECTED GATE PICTURE once bd-01KZXQAW39E8XCXJJVW7C7M2M6 is fixed. Arithmetic from the package own shape rules, not measurement - the real numbers need the fix first. p = 50000, m = 50000 nodes, mean support 31, packed width q(q+1)/2, geometry keeping total + coherent.

  sparse frame, nnz = 1550000          17.9 MB
  frame signature payload after fix    17.9 MB   (currently 18.6 GiB dense)

  q      packed    geometry (2 comp)   query-first   vs 4 GiB
  4      10             0.01 GiB          0.38 MB    ok
  10     55             0.04 GiB          0.38 MB    ok
  20     210            0.16 GiB          0.38 MB    ok
  40     820            0.61 GiB          0.38 MB    ok
  60     1830           1.36 GiB          0.38 MB    ok
  100    5050           3.76 GiB          0.38 MB    ok
  200    20100         14.98 GiB          0.38 MB    query-first only

Crossover: full geometry materialization exceeds 4 GiB at q > 103. Query-first output is m doubles - 0.38 MB - independent of q.

This gives the epic a concrete scope statement rather than a pass/fail: at 50k nodes under 4 GiB, geometry() materialization is supported to roughly q = 100 conditions, and beyond that only the query-first path is. Condition-level RSA sits comfortably inside; trial-level RSA at q = 200 does not and must compile directly to the requested query.

It also CORRECTS something I claimed in the original review. I wrote that "retain geometry before scalarization is exactly what does not scale" and estimated ~10 GB at trial level. The trial-level figure holds - 14.98 GiB at q = 200 - but the crossover is at q ~ 103, which is far higher than I implied. Ordinary condition-level work materializes fine. The philosophy and the engineering only conflict above ~100 conditions, not at ordinary condition counts, and the fair statement is that geometry() has a declared q ceiling rather than that it does not scale.

Two caveats on these numbers: they assume the identity-metric feature-additive path and exclude transient peaks during accumulation, and wall time is a separate gate - measured ~p^1.8 on this path, extrapolating to ~19 minutes at 50k for q = 4 alone, which is the figure that actually needs remeasuring once the memory blocker clears.
